2026-08-26T16:35:00.7950478Z   discussion-body.md \

2026-08-26T16:35:00.7952857Z ```
2026-08-26T16:35:00.7954780Z `jq -Rs` reads the file as a raw string (`-R`) and slurps it into a single JSON string value (`-s`), so `body` is always a valid JSON field. Piping `cat file | safeoutputs ...` does not populate `body` and will be rejected.
